scope: Functional PostgreSQL/Kafka application integration on existing local infrastructure, with isolated test schemas, topics and HTTP listeners; no throughput claim
report_origin: Sanitized aggregate transcription of observed tool output; private connection values and per-poll or voter identifiers are omitted

verified: Public poll and administrative pages served over real HTTP
Administrative operations require authentication
Future admission is not_open and unfinalized results are pending
HTTP 202 confirms Kafka-committed attempts
Concurrent changed repeats preserve the first committed choice of the full identifier
A second controller cannot acquire the same PostgreSQL schema
Termination of only the test-owned PostgreSQL ownership session stops admission and closes writers
A new controller recovers and accepts votes during the original open window
Restart after the deadline recovers an unsealed journal without reopening admission
Late attempts receive HTTP 410
CLOSED replay produces exact canonical totals
Finalization is idempotent
The persisted final result and finalized timestamp survive another controller restart
An unprepared topic containing committed initial control data in only one partition is recoverable
Recovery allocates a fresh unique topic before exposing a prepared writer
The old committed evidence remains readable with read_committed
The prepared topic is reused without rotation on the next restart

code_checks.scope: Follow-up after releasing closed writer references from finalized poll metadata

branch_environment_check.method: bash syntax check and execution of the actual environment generator in an isolated temporary directory; generated values read and asserted without starting services
verified: DATABASE_URL and a generated administrator password are present
An explicit configuration path containing spaces works
Repeated execution preserves an existing selected environment file
Existing .env and .env.simple-files are unchanged

java_discovery_check.method: Linux platform simulated with isolated fake Java executables; no JVM or broker started
verified: Explicit GIGAQUIZZ_KAFKA_JAVA_HOME is used before platform discovery
Linux PATH symlinks resolve to the actual Java installation
Java versions below 21 are rejected
Invalid explicit Java selection does not silently select another installation
Missing Java produces an actionable error without executing the macOS helper

limits: No production HA, power-loss or 1.7-million-HTTP-requests-per-second claim is made
Only the test-owned PostgreSQL ownership backend was terminated; shared PostgreSQL, Kafka brokers and existing sites were not stopped
Synthetic test topics and schemas were preserved
Browser and executable-process SIGKILL verification performed by the root agent is reported separately
Two earlier development runs exposed and fixed token-format handling and omitted pending:false decoding; only successful verification runs are summarized above
